policy.P0: Empty canonical role layer; source research is required before the domain is exposed as populated.
policy.P1: No source signal; use a specialist framework or authoritative occupation source before adding roles.
policy.P2: Some roles lack source evidence or the domain is thin; review title ownership and local context.
policy.P3: Structural mismatch; reconcile the hierarchy before UI acceptance. Domains without a supported subgroup taxonomy use direct domain-to-role navigation.
